messages:
Hana Li: FYI Beacon Labs disputed a mid-cycle billing credit. They received a promo adjustment on INV-2026-2104 but say the discount should have been applied to a different subscription ID (linked accounts). Need to reconcile before issuing anything. @Mikko
Mikko Saarinen: can you paste the invoice lines and the promo code? Quick check first.
Hana Li: INV-2026-2104 excerpt:
- Hosted tokens: 3,400,000 @ $0.0007 = $2,380.00
- Promo applied: BL-SWITCH-30 = -$714.00 (30%)
- Net = $1,666.00
Promo meta: BL-SWITCH-30 intended for new subscription SUB-774 only (one-off migration promo). Beacon says the promo was instead applied to legacy SUB-112 and SUB-774 got none.
Billing Bot: Auto-validate: promo applied to account scope rather than subscription scope due to partner sync mapping mismatch. Created ticket FIN-4678. Suggested corrective path: reverse incorrect credit, reissue correct credit to SUB-774, and create a short explanatory note. GL suggested: 4-2210 for customer credits.
Reese Caldwell: quick math  total intended credit for SUB-774 should be $714 but currently spread across two invoices causing accounting mismatch. We need to reverse the applied -$714 on INV-2026-2104 and create CM against master then reapply to SUB-774. Net customer exposure should be zero but we must fix invoice lines.
Mikko Saarinen: agree. Which instrument do we use — credit memo + reissue or direct invoice edit? Accounting prefers credit memo path for audit trail. Iris, ok to proceed with CM reversal + reissue?
Iris Patel: approve credit memo reversal and reissue. Use two CMs: 1) CM-2026-1407 for $714 reversing INV-2026-2104; 2) CM-2026-1408 applied to SUB-774 (ref SUB-774) for $714. No goodwill needed. Please include partner ops in the note to fix mapping. :white_check_mark:
Hana Li: Draft customer note: "We identified a misapplied migration promo on invoice INV-2026-2104. We reversed the incorrect application and reissued the promo to your migration subscription SUB-774; net billed amount is unchanged. No action required on your end. Apologies for the confusion." Thoughts?
Reese Caldwell: concise and good. Make sure to reference the two CM IDs once created. I'll run create commands now:
/create-credit --cust BeaconLabs --invoice INV-2026-2104 --amt 714 --type credit_memo --ref CM-2026-1407 --reason "promo misapply reversal"
/create-credit --cust BeaconLabs --sub SUB-774 --amt 714 --type credit_memo --ref CM-2026-1408 --reason "promo reissue to migration subscription"
System: CM-2026-1407 and CM-2026-1408 created and queued for posting in EOD batch. FIN-4678 updated and assigned to Partner Ops for mapping fix (OPS-1255).
Mikko Saarinen: GL 4-2210 confirmed. Partner Ops please confirm remediation ETA.
Billing Bot: OPS-1255 created: partner mapping rule updated to enforce subscription-scoped promo application. Remediation ETA 2026-03-22.
Hana Li: I'll notify Beacon Labs once both CMs post and include OPS reference. Closing loop after accounting posts. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
